text:
elaine: Quick sync — post-launch hotpath surgeon sprint plan. Need to decide which customer-facing issues go into a 1-week hotfix vs a 3-week enhancement wave.
elaine: TL;DR: FinMate + Nova reported embedding-quality regressions and a couple streaming disconnect patterns on long sessions. Support tickets #5421 and #5428.
sam: Repro'd the streaming disconnects on dedicated infra. Looks like resume/retry logic isn't being applied consistently after a transient GPU swap. Could be a small patch.
jia: For embeddings: I traced it to quantization fallback not being triggered when the model variant switches mid-request (KV cache boundary). I have a local fix that forces fallback + cache flush.
mark: Support context: FinMate marked #5421 P1 — they have a public demo next Tue. They asked for either a patch or a recommended client workaround to lower their max tokens.
karen: Design thought: if we ship a client workaround, we should show a lightweight inline banner explaining the tradeoff. I can write copy.
triage-bot: auto-tagged tickets: #5421 -> severity:P1; #5428 -> severity:P2; suggested label: release-impact:customer-visible
elaine: Proposal: move the embeddings quantization fix into the 1-week hotfix (owner: jia). For streaming, aim for a short-term resume+backoff in the hotfix (owner: sam) and push the reconnect/redesign to the 3-week enhancement wave.
sam: I can prototype a resume+backoff in ~1 day; it won't be perfect but should drop demo risk substantially.
jia: ETA on patch: 4 days including unit tests + a smoke e2e. I'll open a draft PR today.
mark: If we can ship the two hotfix items to staging by Thu, I can run FinMate's sample through and confirm. Then we can carve a canary for them.
karen: Draft banner copy: "We detected a long session that may cause transient disconnects. Try lowering max tokens or enable \"resume on disconnect\" in client settings." Posting to #design-review.
elaine: Acceptance criteria for hotfix: reproducer added to ticket, unit tests pass, e2e smoke on staging, canary deploy to FinMate with green result.
elaine: Decision recap: embeddings quant fix -> HOTFIX (owner: jia). streaming quick-resume -> HOTFIX (owner: sam) as interim. full streaming reconnect architecture -> ENHANCEMENT WAVE (3-week, owner: infra/streaming). Karen to own user-facing copy and comms. Mark to own customer coordination.
jia: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/201 (WIP) — adding tests and a reproducer.
sam: I'll open a small PR for client resume: https://github.com/redwood-inference/client/pull/452 (draft). Will attach logs.
mark: I'll prepare a short comms template and send to FinMate once PRs are merged to staging.
elaine: Follow-ups: jia & sam to ping here when PRs are ready; I'll move cards on the sprint board and block a Friday 10:00am huddle to confirm canary.
mark: Ack.
karen: Ack — I'll drop the banner copy into #design-review and propose the quick UI.
elaine: Thanks everyone — small, focused hotfix run. If anything blocks, escalate here or @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
